```sql
WITH dd AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    player_name,
    game_id,
    (CASE WHEN pts >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN reb >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN ast >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN stl >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN blk >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS double_digit_cats
  FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats"
  WHERE game_date LIKE '2017%'
)
SELECT
  player_id,
  player_name,
  COUNT(*) AS double_doubles
FROM dd
WHERE double_digit_cats >= 2
GROUP BY player_id, player_name
ORDER BY double_doubles DESC
LIMIT 500
```
